# kkp_service_account_token (Resource)

An API token of a project service account. KKP shows the secret only once, when the token is created, so the provider keeps it in state: treat the state as a secret. Tokens cannot be imported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kkp_service_account_token" "ci" {
  service_account_id = kkp_service_account.ci.id
  name               = "github-actions"
}

output "ci_token" {
  value     = kkp_service_account_token.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Renaming keeps the token.
- `service_account_id` (String) Service account the token belongs to.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `creation_timestamp` (String)
- `expiry` (String) When the token expires (KKP issues tokens valid for three years).
- `id` (String) Token ID, generated by KKP.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer token. Use it as this provider's `token`, or for scripts against the KKP API.
